description: Node 20+ local stdio MCP connector for public service discovery, owner-approved marketplace drafts and publishing, original-only recovery, and browser checkout. No wallet keys or autonomous payments.
rules: Public service listings are descriptive; the buyer verifies checkout readiness and authorizes payment in the browser.
Creator mutations require an owner-approved scoped grant and preserve the original journaled operation on uncertain outcomes.
Checkout is a link for buyer review in the browser; this connector never signs transactions or pays autonomously.
